turns.sql: SELECT (SELECT MIN(Date) FROM badges WHERE UserId = 57) AS FirstBadgeDate, (SELECT MIN(CreaionDate) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = 57) AS FirstPostDate;

SELECT 
  (SELECT MIN(Date) FROM badges WHERE UserId = 57) AS FirstBadgeDate,
  (SELECT MIN(CreaionDate) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = 57) AS FirstPostDate,
  CASE 
    WHEN (SELECT MIN(Date) FROM badges WHERE UserId = 57) < (SELECT MIN(CreaionDate) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = 57) THEN 'badge'
    WHEN (SELECT MIN(Date) FROM badges WHERE UserId = 57) > (SELECT MIN(CreaionDate) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = 57) THEN 'post'
    ELSE 'same'
  END AS EarlierActivity
FROM posts LIMIT 1;

WITH badge_date AS (SELECT MIN("Date") AS d FROM badges WHERE UserId = 57),
     post_date AS (SELECT MIN(CreaionDate) AS d FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = 57)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN bd.d IS NULL AND pd.d IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN bd.d IS NULL THEN pd.d
    WHEN pd.d IS NULL THEN bd.d
    WHEN bd.d <= pd.d THEN bd.d
    ELSE pd.d
  END AS first_activity_date,
  CASE 
    WHEN bd.d IS NULL AND pd.d IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN bd.d IS NULL THEN 'post'
    WHEN pd.d IS NULL THEN 'badge'
    WHEN bd.d <= pd.d THEN 'badge'
    ELSE 'post'
  END AS source
FROM badge_date bd, post_date pd;

WITH badge_date AS (SELECT MIN(Date) AS dt FROM badges WHERE UserId = 57),
post_date AS (SELECT MIN(CreaionDate) AS dt FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = 57)
SELECT 
 CASE 
   WHEN bd.dt IS NULL AND pd.dt IS NULL THEN NULL
   WHEN bd.dt IS NULL THEN pd.dt
   WHEN pd.dt IS NULL THEN bd.dt
   WHEN bd.dt <= pd.dt THEN bd.dt
   ELSE pd.dt
 END AS first_active_date,
 CASE 
   WHEN bd.dt IS NULL AND pd.dt IS NULL THEN NULL
   WHEN bd.dt IS NULL THEN 'first_post'
   WHEN pd.dt IS NULL THEN 'first_badge'
   WHEN bd.dt <= pd.dt THEN 'first_badge'
   ELSE 'first_post'
 END AS source
FROM badge_date bd, post_date pd;

WITH badge_date AS (SELECT MIN(Date) AS dt FROM badges WHERE UserId = 57),
post_date AS (SELECT MIN(CreaionDate) AS dt FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = 57)
SELECT badge_date.dt AS FirstBadgeDate,
       post_date.dt AS FirstPostDate,
       CASE
           WHEN badge_date.dt IS NULL THEN post_date.dt
           WHEN post_date.dt IS NULL THEN badge_date.dt
           WHEN badge_date.dt <= post_date.dt THEN badge_date.dt
           ELSE post_date.dt
       END AS FirstActiveDate
FROM badge_date, post_date;
